from fractions import Fraction as R
T, Q = 1 << 16, 1 << 48
def rne(x):
    n, r = divmod(x.numerator, x.denominator)
    return n + int(2*r > x.denominator or (2*r == x.denominator and n % 2))
h = R(1, 2)
target = h - R(1, 1 << 54)
upper = h + R(1, 1 << 53)
a, b = h - R(1, 1 << 18), h + R(1, 1 << 18)
v = R(16, 375)
s = R(1 << 36, 375)
s_grid = rne(s)
edge_tick = R(Q//2, s_grid)
for x in (h, target, upper, a, b, R(1, 2048), R(375, 32)):
    assert R.from_float(float(x)) == x
assert rne(Q*target) == rne(Q*h) == Q//2
assert R(rne(Q*target), Q)-target == R(1, 1 << 54)
assert rne(Q*upper) == rne(Q*h)
assert rne(T*a) == rne(T*b) == T//2 and b-a == R(1, 1 << 17)
assert h/v < upper/v and upper/v-h/v == R(375, 1 << 57)
assert s_grid == 183251938 and s_grid-s == R(14, 375)
assert (R(768000)-edge_tick)/T == R(7, 2932031008)
assert R(768000)*s_grid-Q//2 == 28672
assert rne(R(1,2)) == 0 and rne(R(3,2)) == 2
